flagged.evidence: The current title describes “Chapter 2 pp. 15-25 and Table 2” as covering “the SI base and derived units, and the exact defining constants h, c and e.” In the cited BIPM brochure, §2.2/Table 1 lists the defining constants, §2.3.1/Table 2 lists SI base units, and derived-unit examples are in Tables 5–6. Table 2 is therefore an inaccurate locator for the derived units and constants; the constants stated in the definition are unaffected.

The current title describes Teschl §9.1 as covering “self-adjoint boundary conditions for first-order differential expressions on an interval.” Teschl §9.1 is on Sturm–Liouville operators; its equation (9.1) is a second-order expression, and the boundary-condition discussion concerns that expression. It does not support the cited description of first-order momentum expressions. The item gives a local proof, which does not correct the citation.

The current title attributes “the projective composition of boosts u1,u2 to u1+u2” to Torre §6 equation (6.2). Equation (6.2) gives the boost wave-function law; equations (6.3)–(6.4) show that pure boosts compose ordinarily, while the projective phase appears in equation (6.8) for a boost combined with a spatial translation. The cited claim and locator are inaccurate.
